# sdm-proxy-cluster-kit

Install, debug and check a StrongDM proxy cluster worker on a Linux host with systemd. This community-maintained kit is published by [jmojo-dev](https://github.com/jmojo-dev).

## Install the verified release

The installer needs root to create the `sdm` service account, install the StrongDM CLI, and configure the `sdm-worker` systemd service. It collects the cluster credentials and seals them as the service user. Replacing an existing installation can interrupt sessions and requires explicit approval. [Changes by mode](#what-each-mode-changes-on-the-system) · [Live PostgreSQL and EC2 test results](tests/results/0.1.2.md)

On the target Linux host, run the following as your regular user with an authenticated GitHub CLI. It downloads version 0.1.2 to a private directory and verifies GitHub’s release attestation before invoking `sudo`.

```bash
(
  set -e
  cd "$(mktemp -d)"
  gh release download v0.1.2 --repo jmojo-dev/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit --pattern install.sh
  gh release verify-asset v0.1.2 ./install.sh --repo jmojo-dev/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit
  sudo bash ./install.sh
)
```

You can review the full installer in your browser before running it. If the target has no GitHub CLI, download and verify on a trusted workstation, then transfer those verified bytes over your authenticated deployment channel. [Installer source for v0.1.2](https://github.com/jmojo-dev/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit/blob/v0.1.2/dist/install.sh) · [Release assets](https://github.com/jmojo-dev/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit/releases/tag/v0.1.2)

| Mode | Menu | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `install` | 1 New install | Installs or repairs a worker. Asks for every secret up front, before it changes anything. |
| `debug` | 2 Debug install | Turns on verbose logging, restarts, follows the logs, and turns it off again when you stop. |
| `check` | 3 Check install | Checks the host and worker. Live Delinea authentication is opt-in. |

## The layout is fixed

The kit does not ask about any of these. The choices are deliberate and do not change.

| What | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Service user | `sdm` (nologin shell, locked password), home `/home/sdm` |
| `SDM_HOME` | `/home/sdm/.sdm` (identity `state.kv`, sealed secrets `secretenv.enc`) |
| Binary | `/opt/strongdm/bin/sdm` |
| systemd unit | `sdm-worker` |
| Environment file | `/etc/sysconfig/sdm-worker` (on Debian and Ubuntu too) |
| Logs | **journald**: `journalctl -u sdm-worker` |
| The kit itself | `/opt/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit.sh` (root, 0700) |
| Kit transcripts | `/var/log/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit/<mode>-<timestamp>.log` (0600), or `/opt/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit/logs/` when `/var/log` allows group writes |

The worker writes to journald. Use the service unit to follow its output.

```bash
journalctl -u sdm-worker -f            # follow
journalctl -u sdm-worker --since -1h   # last hour
```

### Upgrading from v0.1.0

Install the verified new release into its administrative directory. Update scheduled jobs, bookmarks and runbooks to invoke `/opt/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit.sh`. Retire invocations of the old copy under the worker-owned `/opt/strongdm/kit`. The new kit ignores that copy and its installation records. An existing sealed worker can prompt for a decision about key rotation on its first run.

### Download with curl

From a private working directory, download the versioned asset and verify it before running it. [GitHub CLI verification](https://cli.github.com/manual/gh_release_verify-asset)

```bash
curl --fail --show-error --silent --location --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
  --output install.sh 'https://github.com/jmojo-dev/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit/releases/download/v0.1.2/install.sh' &&
  gh release verify-asset v0.1.2 ./install.sh --repo jmojo-dev/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit &&
  sudo bash ./install.sh
```

### Terminals with paste-only access

Download and verify the release asset `paste-me.txt` using the same procedure, substituting its filename in both commands. Open the verified local file. On the target, enter a root shell and wait for the prompt before pasting the entire file. The embedded checksum detects a damaged paste. If the terminal truncates it, transfer the verified installer as a file.

### Restoring a foreign-install backup

Choose a backup directory containing the `COMPLETE` marker. On a trusted recovery machine, verify the backup files with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` from the timestamped backup directory. Recover one file with `openssl cms -decrypt -binary -inform DER -in FILE.cms -inkey RECOVERY.key -out RECOVERED`. A recovered directory is a tar archive. Inspect it in a private directory before restoring selected files.

### Automation

Stage and verify the versioned artifact before obtaining credentials. Run it from a private directory as the deployment identity. Supply only the documented variables needed for the selected mode. Retrieve secret values at run time from the organization's secret manager. Keep them out of command arguments, shell tracing, instance user-data and infrastructure state. Set `KIT_MODE` and `KIT_NONINTERACTIVE=1` for unattended runs.

### Publishing a GitHub release

For a first public release from a private development repository, publish the reviewed source snapshot in a new public repository. Pushing the existing development history also publishes earlier revisions. Enable immutable releases in the intended repository. Build from the reviewed revision, attach the artifacts from `dist/` and their checksum manifest to a draft release, then publish the draft. Verify the attached asset against its release attestation before announcing the tag. [GitHub immutable releases](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/concepts/supply-chain-security/immutable-releases)

### Environment variables

The build generates this table from `# @env NAME  description` lines in `src/`.

<!-- ENV:BEGIN -->

| Variable | Used by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DELINEA_PASSWORD` | install | Delinea Secret Server password, sealed into the node secret store (never printed) |
| `DELINEA_SERVER_URL` | install | Optional Delinea server URL written to /etc/sysconfig/sdm-worker (blank = configured on the secret store in the Admin UI) |
| `DELINEA_USERNAME` | install | Delinea Secret Server username, sealed into the node secret store |
| `HTTPS_PROXY` | check | the operator shell's proxy (also https_proxy/HTTP_PROXY/http_proxy/NO_PROXY/no_proxy); replaced by the worker's own proxy settings so the checks see what the worker sees |
| `KIT_ASSUME_YES` | debug, install | 1 = answer yes to the confirmations when non-interactive |
| `KIT_BACKUP_CERT` | install | Path to a root-protected PEM encryption certificate for foreign-install backups; keep the private key offline |
| `KIT_CHECK_DELINEA` | check | yes\|no - run or skip the Delinea section without asking (default: run when any DELINEA_* setting is found) |
| `KIT_DEBUG_FILTER` | debug | log filter: all \| secrets \| rdp \| errors (non-interactive default: all) |
| `KIT_DEBUG_KEEP` | debug | 1 = leave SDM_VERBOSE=true in place when done (no revert) |
| `KIT_DEBUG_MINUTES` | debug | minutes to follow the journal before reverting (default 30, max 1440) |
| `KIT_DEBUG_UNIT` | debug | unit to debug when several sdm units exist (e.g. sdm-worker) |
| `KIT_DELINEA` | install | yes\|no - will this cluster use Delinea Secret Server (default when unset and non-interactive: yes if DELINEA_USERNAME is set) |
| `KIT_DELINEA_CA_FILE` | check | Optional operator-approved CA bundle for live authentication |
| `KIT_DELINEA_LIVE` | check | yes = enable live authentication to the explicitly supplied HTTPS server; default no |
| `KIT_DELINEA_PASSWORD_PATH` | check | the resource's password secret path, e.g. 1234?key=Password (empty = skip) |
| `KIT_DELINEA_SERVER_URL` | check | Trusted HTTPS server URL supplied by the operator for live checks |
| `KIT_DELINEA_SVC_PASSWORD` | check | service-account password, used only when DELINEA_PASSWORD is sealed; never printed |
| `KIT_DELINEA_SVC_USERNAME` | check | service-account username, used only when DELINEA_USERNAME is sealed (unreadable by design) |
| `KIT_DELINEA_USERNAME_PATH` | check | the resource's username secret path, e.g. 1234?key=Username (empty = skip) |
| `KIT_DELINEA_VAULT_URL` | check | Trusted HTTPS vault URL from the Admin UI for Platform checks |
| `KIT_FORCE_REINSTALL` | install | yes = reprovision the CLI, sealed keys and unit on an existing worker |
| `KIT_MODE` | main | install \| debug \| check - skip the menu (required when there is no terminal) |
| `KIT_NONINTERACTIVE` | main | 1 = never prompt even if a terminal exists; every input must come from env vars |
| `KIT_RDP_HOST` | check | RDP target host[:port] to test TCP reachability from this worker (empty = skip) |
| `KIT_REPLACE` | install | yes = allow replacing a foreign StrongDM install when non-interactive (instead of typing REPLACE) |
| `KIT_ROTATE_DELINEA` | install | yes = replace an existing sealed Delinea username and password. Ordinary repairs keep the existing pair. |
| `KIT_START_TIMEOUT` | install | Seconds to wait for the worker to come up (default 90) |
| `NO_COLOR` | main | any value disables colour output |
| `SDM_APP_DOMAIN` | install | Control plane region: app.strongdm.com, app.eu.strongdm.com or app.uk.strongdm.com (skips the region menu) |
| `SDM_BIND_ADDRESS` | install | Worker listen address (default :8443; never prompted) |
| `SDM_PROXY_CLUSTER_ACCESS_KEY` | install | Proxy cluster access key (skips the prompt) |
| `SDM_PROXY_CLUSTER_SECRET_KEY` | install | Proxy cluster secret key (skips the hidden prompt; never printed) |

<!-- ENV:END -->

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | OK |
| 1 | A check or operation failed |
| 2 | Usage error or missing input (for example, a required variable in non-interactive mode) |
| 3 | Precondition not met: not root, no systemd, unsupported OS, container, or bootstrap without sudo/terminal |
| 4 | The operator declined a confirmation |

## What each mode changes on the system

| Mode | Changes |
| --- | --- |
| all | The bootstrap installs the administrative kit under `/opt/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit`. Root runs save a private transcript. |
| `install` | Creates the service user, verifies the regional CLI archive, and provisions the worker CLI and systemd unit. All worker-state writes and node-secret operations run as `sdm`. The kit requires successful sealing before starting the worker. The service manager reads a root-owned environment file. SELinux enforcement stays active throughout provisioning. |
| `install` on an existing worker | Preserves worker identity and local environment settings. After an interrupted change, rerun install with the intended settings. The kit verifies readiness against the running worker before clearing the pending change. Reprovisioning or applying changes can drop sessions. |
| Delinea credentials | Set `KIT_DELINEA=yes` and supply the pair for first-time provisioning. A rerun reuses the sealed pair and removes legacy plaintext entries. To change the pair, supply both new values and set `KIT_ROTATE_DELINEA=yes`, or select rotation at the interactive prompt. Workers using `SDM_SECRETS_FILE` get credentials from that file. |
| `install` replacing a foreign worker | Requires explicit replacement approval and a public X.509 certificate in `KIT_BACKUP_CERT`. It verifies CMS-encrypted backups in `/var/backups/sdm-proxy-cluster-kit/` and records the original files and service states before switching workers. A failed replacement restores the prior installation. After a hard kill or power loss, rerun install to trigger recovery. Keep the backup private key offline. |
| `debug` | Temporarily enables `SDM_VERBOSE=true` via a systemd drop-in under `/run` and restarts the worker, dropping its active sessions. Exiting normally restores the previous configuration. A systemd timer enforces `KIT_DEBUG_MINUTES` (default 30) even if the debugger is killed. A reboot clears the runtime override. Set `KIT_DEBUG_KEEP=1` to keep verbose logging across reboots. |
| `check` | Inspects local state and makes connectivity probes. Set `KIT_DELINEA_LIVE=yes` and supply `KIT_DELINEA_SERVER_URL` from the Admin UI to authenticate over HTTPS. Platform checks also require the approved `KIT_DELINEA_VAULT_URL`. Credentialed requests go directly to the approved server, using the host trust store or an explicitly configured protected CA bundle. |

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause and fix |
| --- | --- |
| `PASTE WAS TRUNCATED OR MANGLED` | The terminal dropped or changed part of the paste. Nothing ran. Copy the entire verified local asset and paste again. If it fails twice, transfer the verified installer as a file. |
| Stuck at `>` prompts after pasting | The end of the paste never arrived. Press Ctrl-C and paste again. |
| `NOT ROOT - nothing was run` | Run `sudo -i`, then paste again. |
| Paste "disappeared" after a password prompt | sudo read the pasted lines as the password. Run `sudo -i` on its own first, then paste. |
| AWS SSM Session Manager browser console | Large pastes can be slow, cut short, or rejected. Wait until the paste has finished echoing before you press Enter. If a complete paste fails, transfer the verified installer as a file. Starting the session from the AWS CLI (`aws ssm start-session`) in a local terminal pastes more reliably than the browser. |
| Menu answers itself or skips a question | Something was pasted after the block, and the kit read it as input. Paste only the block. |
| `needs bash 4.2+` | Very old OS. Supported: RHEL/Rocky/Alma 7-9, Amazon Linux 2/2023, Ubuntu, Debian. |
| `curl` or `unzip` missing | `install` installs them with dnf/yum/apt. Without repo access, install them yourself (`dnf install -y curl unzip` or `apt-get install -y curl unzip`). |
| `gzip or sha256sum is missing` | Minimal images only: `dnf install -y gzip coreutils` (or yum/apt-get), then paste again. |
| SELinux enforcing, worker fails to start (`status=203/EXEC` or permission denied) | `check` reports the SELinux mode. Look for denials with `ausearch -m avc -ts recent`, and review the path labels and the local policy with the host administrator. |
| An active worker lacks startup or authsync evidence | Inspect `journalctl -b -u sdm-worker`. If its startup entries have expired, a healthy rerun leaves the worker running and reports that readiness could not be verified. |
| Replacement reports an unmanaged StrongDM process | Stop it through its original launch mechanism before rerunning install. The kit needs a service it can restore on failure. |
| Running in a container | `check` works, and `debug` explains what it would do. `install` refuses with exit 3: a worker belongs on a VM or host with systemd. |

## Support transcripts

Transcripts and journal exports can contain hostnames, account names, paths, configuration and service output. Review and redact them locally before sharing. Keep backups of worker configuration in restricted storage.

## Building and testing

Run the Linux test matrix with Docker and Go installed on the development machine. Go builds the loopback TLS test fixture.

```bash
tools/build.sh                                   # dist/*, README.md; fails on TABs, long lines, bash -n, missing modes
KIT_BASE_URL=https://example.com/kit tools/build.sh
tests/run.sh                                     # every test on every image (docker)
tests/run-systemd.sh                             # worker lifecycle, recovery and debug expiry
tests/run.sh -i ubuntu:22.04 -i centos:7 -t build/paste   # filter by image / test
```

`dist/` is generated. Change `src/` (modes go in `src/modes/<mode>.sh`) and
`tools/templates/`, then rebuild.
